execution_entry: evals.runner.run_case / HarnessSession; no separate Agent loop
adapter_status: Not implemented in this checkpoint. runner-source.json is controller metadata, not a runnable EvalCase or model payload.

adapter_contract.prepare: Use PreparedFixture from the bare pinned base only, fresh local Git history and separate task environment; never reuse a reference-installed editable environment.
adapter_contract.agent: Only problem_statement, base source and generic runner instructions; no evaluator paths, reference fixes, test patch, hints or future history.
adapter_contract.grade: After Agent termination and owned-process cleanup, preserve candidate diff, restore trusted base test/config files and apply the pinned test_patch on an evaluator copy; grade against the frozen mapping with independent task dependencies. Never install or expose the gold patch during model execution.
adapter_contract.accounting: Reuse HarnessSession budgets and outcome records. Count every started slot, classify setup/model/budget/cancellation/grader/cleanup failures; keep successful costs separate. No second Agent loop.
adapter_contract.leakage: Audit Journal tool reads/commands for evaluator artifacts, future commits and answer exposure; any observed leakage marks the attempt invalid and never successful. Workspace separation does not prevent host reads/network under the current partial native boundary.

source_policy: Record tested ForgeCode commit and clean tree before execution; do not change implementation within the plan.
attempt_accounting: One slot starts at setup admission; failed setup recorded separately with zero model requests. Every model-attempted slot remains in operational completion denominator. No retries, replacements or new samples after model results.
full_success: run_case passed AND completed terminal status AND nonempty allowed diff AND successful independent frozen F2P/P2P grading AND clean cleanup. Budget-exhausted/cancelled/infra failures are not success.

statistics.completion: All attempted slots with failures by category; setup failures separately visible.
statistics.paired: For two-success repeats report within-task paired costs; no before/after improvement inference without frozen comparison conditions.
statistics.missing_usage: null, never zero; retain total known consumption across all attempts.

gates_before_paid_execution: All six current-source frozen native preflights accepted
Shared runner adapter and evaluator-only test restoration validated without model calls
Record and verify exact ForgeCode runtime commit, manifest/environment hashes and model config
Enforce cap at actual request boundary including any routing/subagent/retry, no automatic retries
